_about: The homepage's debates (Jorge, Nov 26, 2026): each a question fans really argue about, the board it opens and the player it puts in play (his headshot, and the hero's tier buttons place him on that board). On every page load the hero and the three featured cards are drawn at random from here, no repeats on one page, the hero never the visitor's last one; months = when the debate is in season (weighted up then). scripts/build-templates.mjs checks every board and player and copies this to public/hero.json.
